facts.fact: The Konza Technopolis Development Authority, a state agency, says it is operationalising a National Data Center offering a wide array of digital services to both government and private enterprises, including cloud, hosting and colocation, in a call for partners opened 8 July 2025.
The Konza Technopolis Development Authority describes the Konza National Data Center it is operationalising as Tier III certified, in a call for partners opened 8 July 2025.
